messages:
maria: Heads-up — the node sampleapp is showing the same reqid for different requests after a hot-reload, pretty consistently. Prob related to logger autoinit race.

sam: Can you paste the exact logs and which SDK version you have?

maria: Node SDK 1.4.0. Running with nodemon + ts-node. Env: LOG_LEVEL=debug, REDWOOD_OTEL_ENABLE=true. Example snippet:```[2024-05-01T12:00:01Z] app:info reqid=abc123 GET /api/generate started
[2024-05-01T12:00:01Z] app:info reqid=abc123 GET /api/generate finished```

alex: That looks like a request-id getter being bound to a shared logger instance that survives reloads. If the OTEL hook hasn't re-registered the per-request middleware, the logger will use a cached/global getter.

jen: Does hot-reload mean nodemon is swapping modules in-place? We've seen a circular require/race where initLogger() returns the previous logger instance without re-binding middleware.

maria: Exactly. Repro steps: start, hit endpoint a few times, then touch a file to trigger reload, then make concurrent requests — they all show the last seen reqid.

sam: @maria can you try forcing explicit ordering: import telemetry/init before creating the HTTP server? If that fixes, we can decide whether to change the sampleapp or SDK default.

maria: Tried that — forcing init before server start fixes it. So it's an init-order problem. But the quickstart pattern currently autoinits lazily, which makes the onboarding fragile for dev workflows.

alex: Potential fixes: 1) Make SDK autoinit idempotent and expose a Promise-ready API (e.g., sdk.telemetry.ready()). 2) OTEL hook should defensively generate a per-request fallback reqId when context is missing. 3) Document nodemon/hot-reload caveat in sampleapp README.

jen: I can open a small PR to move init early in the sampleapp quickstart and add a note about nodemon. Also add a tiny integration test that simulates module reload.

telemetry-bot: New issue created: #3789 "logger autoinit race with otel hook on hot reload" by jen

sam: Another related doc item — point out that LOG_LEVEL=debug can expose PII unless REDACT is enabled. We should add a stern note in onboarding and the quickstart about default redaction behavior.

maria: Yup saw a help ticket where DEBUG + REDACT=false printed full emails into logs. Caused an internal compliance question.

alex: Action items: jen -> sampleapp PR to init earlier + test; telemetry team -> RFC for ready() API; docs -> add redaction + nodemon caveats. I'll move to backlog and assign owners.

maria: Thanks — happy to help validate the PR once it's up.
